race.comment: BOLD NOMAD (13) returns and looks the one to beat off a dominant trial win here on the inner surface. Was sound on debut without threatening and appears to have to come on a treat during the break. Maloney's booking is the cherry on top. VUKAS (7) has to be taken partly on trust after offering little on debut at Doomben, but he was respected in an open market that day and his trials in readiness suggest he's developed nicely. Again, a key booking in Thompson is a strong lead. SHE'S HOTSTUFF (14) resumes with a nice trial win behind her after a quiet debut prep. Keeping safe for a minor spot. Debutant SHEZA TRAP (11) has trialled well and deserves respect.
